# Deep research: multi-phase research report writer

Curated by Skill Harbor — @claude-office-skills' deep-research skill: a five-phase method (scoping, information gathering, analysis, synthesis, reporting) for comprehensive multi-perspective research on any topic, with PESTEL and 5W1H frameworks, argument mapping with counter-argument rebuttals, and four ready-made output formats — executive brief, standard 5–10 page report, 15+ page deep dive, or slide-ready bullets — all with sources, key findings and recommendations. Pairs with the sibling `academic-search` skill for the literature side. Honest caveats: guidance only — no live internet access, no paywalled or proprietary databases, no primary research (surveys, interviews), no 100%-accuracy guarantee; its own footer says findings should be verified with primary sources for critical decisions; it references the project's office-mcp server (create_docx, create_xlsx) for document output, which you must have wired up; MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
